desc:
Your football (soccer) career: sign for any club at 16, or start at 8 in the academy, and make it all the way to the Golden Ball.

⚽ Play the big moments: penalties, free kicks, one on ones, headers and saves. A coach shows you how, and your skill decides.
📈 Build your player to 99, season by season.
✍️ Contracts, transfers and transfer windows. The Clubs app shows what each club wants from you.
🌍 Play for your country at the World Nations Cup, and chase the Continental Cup with your club.
📱 Your phone: news about you, texts from your agent, Kickfie and your fans.
🏆 Win the Golden Ball, retire a legend and make the Hall of Fame.
👥 Play with friends: +10% money while a Roblox friend is in your server.

No luck rolls. No rerolls. No energy. Your choices and your skill decide your career.

An unofficial fan game. Names are made up or parodies and every crest is original. Not affiliated with any real club, league, federation or player.
